title: Pad second opinion
summary: A second opinion written under each note on the pad. It asks your record's model about every note with no reply, so each note spends some of its allowance.
changes: The first version: the second opinion the pad used to write itself, now an add-on of its own. Now draws its own icon.
author: BrainDog

declarations.name: Write a second opinion under each note

ask_slash.question: Give a short second opinion on this note, in two or three plain sentences: what it gets right, and what it may be missing. The note: {{trigger.row.text}}
